data.long_meaning: Anzala is derived from the Arabic word 'anzal' which means 'to send down' or 'to bring help and assistance'. The name Anzala carries the meaning “Help, Assistance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anzala usually hope their child will grow to embody help, assistance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Babur was known for his military conquests, and the name Anzala has been historically used as a name for boys born during times of hardship, struggle, or change, reflecting the idea that Allah sends down help and assistance in times of need. The name also carries the common Islamic themes of faith and perseverance, as well as a connection to the rich history and culture of the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: Anzala is also a deeply spiritual name in Islamic tradition, invoking the concept of Allah's mercy and compassion as the one who sends down help and assistance. It is a reminder of the belief that no matter how difficult or trying circumstances may be, Allah is always present and ready to lend a helping hand. It is a name that inspires faith, hope, and trust in Allah's infinite mercy and kindness, and is a source of comfort and strength for those going through challenging times. Additionally, the name Anzala is also associated with the idea of Allah's messengers and prophets coming to humanity with guidance and assistance, reinforcing the spiritual connection between the divine and the human experience.
